description: Returns turva.dev's own agent-readiness reading from the independent scanner isitagentready.com, with the overall score and level, the category sub-scores and the measurement date. Use this when a user asks for turva.dev's agent-readiness score or level, or wants to check the claim behind the audit service. For web and email security scan results use get_security_evidence, and when a user asks for evidence in general, call both. The reading is compiled into the server and changes only on deploy, so check its date. The scanner link in the result opens the scanner's start page, where anyone can run a new check, and not the recorded reading.
name: get_agent_readiness

domain.description: The domain the reading is about.

note.description: A caveat that the scores are a point-in-time reading by an independent scanner and that the scan url opens the scanner's start page.

scans.description: Readings from independent scanners, one per entry.

additionalProperties.description: The category score as text, out of 100.

categories.description: Sub-scores by category. Each key is a category name: discoverability, content, bot_access_control, api_auth_mcp_a2a_discovery or commerce. The key api_auth_mcp_a2a_discovery is the group the scanner's page labels API, Auth, MCP & Skill Discovery. On the scanner's own page, commerce is shown for information and does not count toward the score.

note.description: Who runs the scanner and a reminder that the reading is the scanner's and can be re-run by anyone.

provider.description: The domain of the scanner that produced the reading.

result.description: The scanner's overall result as text, giving the score out of 100 and the level reached.

url.description: The scanner's start page, where a new check can be run. It does not show the recorded reading.

title: Agent-readiness score
